{"subject":"things a family visiting for a few days can turn up to with young children: museums, zoos, aquariums, playgrounds","town":"New York, NY","stage":"preschool","window":"September 12 to 15"}

content.text:
I found three places that suit a preschooler. The hours below are the ones each venue's own site publishes for the 2026 season. Today is October 12, 2026, so September 12 to 15 has already passed this year. If the visit is next September, check the hours again, because I found nothing posted for 2027.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Children's Museum of Manhattan (CMOM), Upper West Side",
      "age_fit": "children ages 0-6",
      "when": "Tuesday-Sunday, 10am-5pm; the site lists Monday as closed outside summer",
      "source_name": "Children's Museum of Manhattan"
    },
    {
      "name": "Central Park Zoo (includes Tisch Children's Zoo)",
      "age_fit": "children 3-12 ticketed as children; under 3 free",
      "when": "Opens daily at 10am. April-October it closes at 5pm Monday-Friday and 5:30pm on weekends and holidays; last entry is 1 hour before closing",
      "source_name": "Central Park Zoo"
    },
    {
      "name": "New York Aquarium, Coney Island",
      "age_fit": "Child (3-12) ticket; children 2 and under free",
      "when": "Daily Sept 8 - Oct 31, 2026: opens 10am, last entry 4pm, closes 5pm",
      "price": "Child (3-12) $25.95 off-peak, $27.95 peak; adult $29.95 off-peak, $32.95 peak",
      "source_name": "New York Aquarium"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **CMOM:** I did not find a ticket price on their pages. Their site says 
tickets can be bought online in advance or right before your visit, and booking online saves $1.
 Their visitor guidelines page also lists Monday to Sunday hours for July to September, which conflicts with the Tuesday to Sunday hours on their main pages. For a Monday visit, call them on 212-721-1223.
- **Central Park Zoo:** 
April to October, the zoo grounds close at 5pm Monday through Friday and 5:30pm on weekends and holidays.
 The official page I read did not show the price, so I left it out. Third-party sites say tickets are date-specific and bought online in advance, which the zoo's own FAQ page does not confirm for every ticket type.
- **New York Aquarium:** 
Advance tickets are required for Wednesday afternoon reduced admission and are made available at 3:00pm the Monday before.
 The aquarium is in Brooklyn, a subway or bus ride from Manhattan.

I did not get to a playground. The three above are all museum, zoo or aquarium picks.
